## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3618 (spec 0.364), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/sony-ericsson-hazel-superior-black.jpg (official image, the open phone cut out)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/sony-ericsson-hazel-superior-black.jpg); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_hazel-3058.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/hazel/).
